record.question: Biaka went to market to purchase pencils and pens. The cost one pencil is Rs 3 and the cost of one pen is Rs 5. If he spent Rs 60 on 14 items, then the number of pens he purchased was
record.explanation: Let pencils p, pens n; p+n=14 and 3p+5n=60. Subtract 3(p+n)=42: 2n=18, n=9. Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
